integrity_verdict.scientific_assessment: No verbatim prompt duplicate leakage detected between train and test_held_out. However, because the dataset was created via random shuffle across CBR-04 and CBR-05 rather than template-disjoint or entity-disjoint splitting, test_held_out shares identical prompt templates and identical static response phrases (e.g. persona strings, epistemic abstention phrases, and city query syntaxes) with the training set. Therefore, test_held_out tests in-distribution generalization on held-out instances, NOT out-of-distribution or novel-template generalization.
